_meta.basis: Inferred from the pattern across 12 signed contracts. The client confirms there is no written rule: 'It is Karan's preference... There is no fixed rule or no fixed philosophy.' Every position below is an observed pattern, not an instruction.

positions.name: Liability cap
positions.denominator_note: The denominator is NOT consistent. Contracts variously use total fees under the agreement, fees under the relevant SOW, and fees in the trailing twelve months. Read it from the clause; do not assume.

deviations.term: greater of trailing 12-month referral fees or USD 100,000
2x fees for Breach or BAA violation

deviations.note: Client confirms this was noticed only afterwards, during due diligence. Cost $23,200 on a $92,000 deal.

positions.name: Liquidated damages / delay penalty
positions.position: Capped, typically 5% of the milestone fee or 10% of total fees
positions.observed: Al Noor 10% aggregate (cl. 10.3); Acme, Trustline, Sunrise 5% per milestone

positions.name: Background IP
positions.position: AtliQ retains pre-existing tools, libraries and know-how; client gets a perpetual non-exclusive royalty-free licence as incorporated in the deliverables
positions.observed: 6 of 8 contracts with an IP clause

deviations.term: full assignment including AtliQ background IP

positions.name: Proportionality to contract value
positions.position: Risk exposure should bear a sensible ratio to what the deal is worth
positions.client_quote: Each contract is judged fresh. And sometimes with respect to the contract value. E.g. a 12 month contract worth $2k/month with a liability of $500k is a deal in bad faith.
positions.threshold_status: NOT CONFIRMED. The client gave one example but no boundary. Bands below are the product team's proposal, pending his confirmation.
